notes: Dev-split ABox revision on has_currency (functional, inverse:currency_of). Related near uses functionality as an application (should a traveller get yen?), the README's functional template ('is c still a's R?') in a practical frame. Related far is a composition on the new value: the ISO 4217 code of Japan's currency, stored with the yen ('Japanese yen (JPY)'), moves to EUR because a currency has one code; the code's letters echo Japan, so a model that answers JPY from the country's name has not carried the edit through, and that is no world. Derived: two compositions on the euro that are not tied to Japan by their wording (whether Japan now shares France's currency; whether its currency existed in the 1950s, which needs the euro's 1999 start, logic fol with temporal) and a binding through the nickname 'Land of the Rising Sun'. The earlier related far question (which central bank sets Japan's monetary policy) was dropped: its class rule fails for unilateral euro users (Montenegro, Kosovo), so a Japan that uses the euro could keep the Bank of Japan; with it went the topic's inheritance question here, which finance-replace-d001 now carries (India's single time zone). The currency-symbol question was dropped too: '¥' is written with 'Japanese yen' and is not clearly worked out. Eurozone membership is not asked: the euro is also used by non-members, so 'uses the euro' does not make a country a member. Denmark's currency is edited in the main split (finance-replace-0001); this record edits another country's, so no fact is shared.
